document.title: Fix stale glossary, document SDK config, prune dead theme and files
document.summary: A hygiene pass over several independent stories: `CONTEXT.md` corrected against the shipped code, a new SDK README section on project configuration, removal of the light theme, a stray HTML doc, and an empty workspace package, memo-free minesweeper, and a consistent oxlint ignore list.
document.why: [#59](source:s1) reports that `CONTEXT.md` still calls Runtime Upload future work, that the SDK README omits config, assets and generated types, and that dead files, manual memoization, and a lint inconsistency remain.

sources.title: [Claude] Docs and hygiene: stale CONTEXT.md, stray files, example drift
sources.gist: Lists stale glossary lines, a stray HTML doc, missing SDK README topics, manual memoization, duplicated example configs, a lint ignore gap, and the dead light theme.

sources.label: PR #71
sources.gist: One commit per issue item, with the glossary changes listed against src/.

lookFor: [#59](source:s1) names four identical example configs; the per-example `package.json`, `tsconfig.json` and `vitadeck-env.d.ts` stay because they already extend the SDK preset and mirror the author scaffold. Only `js/examples/package.json` is removed.
[#59](source:s1) also asks the SDK README to cover build mode; this PR leaves the Build section alone because open PR #63 adds the `--dev` flag there.

parts.name: Glossary
parts.summary: `CONTEXT.md` definitions, relationships, dialogue, and ambiguities now match the Shell and Runtime Upload code on `main`.

parts.name: SDK README
parts.summary: A new Project configuration section documents `vitadeck.config.json`, assets, the tsconfig preset, and generated name types.

parts.name: Theme
parts.summary: The SDK exposes only the dark theme, without `ThemeName` or a theme name field.

parts.name: Examples
parts.summary: Minesweeper drops manual memoization and the empty `@vitadeck/examples` package leaves the workspace.

parts.name: Lint
parts.summary: One ignore covers both rolldown configs, and chat helper scripts are linted.

groups.title: Glossary matches the shipped Shell and upload flow
groups.why: [#59](source:s1) says `CONTEXT.md` still calls Runtime Upload future work and claims Button is the only interactive element.
groups.summary: Each Shell, upload-listener, and input statement is rewritten in place to describe what `src/shell/shell.c`, `src/ui/input.c`, and `src/core/package_library.c` do, with no new terms.
lookFor: Subtle: **Shell Upload Screen** keeps its name but now means the running state of the Upload row on the Shell Home Screen, because no separate upload view exists in `shell.c`.
The listener now documents as running until Shell Upload Cancel or exit, including while the Shell is hidden; `hide_shell_to_deck` and `activate_package` never call `upload_server_stop`.
Activation is no longer always explicit: `package_library_publish_package` activates the uploaded package when no Active Deck App is set, and startup activates the first library entry.

groups.title: SDK README documents project configuration
groups.why: [#59](source:s1) says the README never mentions `vitadeck.config.json` fields, fonts and images, generated `.vitadeck` types, or the tsconfig preset.
groups.summary: The new section restates the rules `readConfig`, `readFonts`, `readImages` and `writeFontTypes` in `cli/cli.ts` enforce, for authors.

groups.title: Delete the unused light theme
groups.why: [#59](source:s1) notes the theme is fixed to `dark` while `light` is exported.
groups.summary: `ThemeProvider` in `theme.tsx` serves one constant `Theme`, so `index.tsx` stops exporting `ThemeName` and the smoke fixture prints the literal `dark`.
lookFor: Breaking: authors importing `ThemeName`, reading `theme.name`, or destructuring `themeName` from `useTheme()` get type errors; `useTheme().theme` colors are unchanged.
The smoke label text stays `SDK / runtime / theme: dark` because `render.c` concatenates raw-text children, so the golden does not move.

groups.title: Minesweeper without useMemo/useCallback
groups.why: `AGENTS.md` asks for React Compiler code with no manual `useMemo`/`useCallback`, and [#59](source:s1) flags minesweeper for it.
groups.summary: Each memoized callback and derived value in `MinesweeperDeckApp` becomes a plain function or expression with the same body.

groups.title: Drop the empty examples workspace package
groups.why: [#59](source:s1) calls `js/examples/package.json` a workspace package with no purpose.
groups.summary: Removing `js/examples/package.json` goes with removing its `examples` entry from `pnpm-workspace.yaml` and its lockfile importer.

groups.title: Consistent oxlint ignores; lint chat scripts
groups.summary: The `**/rolldown*.config.*` ignore replaces two patterns, and a `scripts/*.mjs` override lets the chat script be linted, which forces its `import.meta.dirname` fix.
lookFor: The override turns off `no-unsafe-assignment`, `no-unsafe-call` and `no-unsafe-member-access` for `**/scripts/*.mjs` only; no tsconfig covers those files, so those rules see unresolved types there.

groups.title: Delete scroll-container.html
groups.summary: A 678-line AI-generated explainer from 7241e81 is deleted; nothing in the repo links to it, so the deletion is safe to skim.

commits.subject: docs(context): match the glossary to the shipped Shell and Runtime Upload
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Runtime Upload is shipped; the upload UI is a toggle row on the Shell
Home Screen; the listener only stops on Shell Upload Cancel or exit;
the first publish activates when nothing is active; Button is the only
Press component while Scroll takes scroll input; host mappings apply on
macOS and Linux.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: refactor(sdk): delete the unused light theme
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
The runtime always provided the dark theme; nothing could select light.
Removes the light palette, the ThemeName type, Theme.name and
ThemeContextValue.themeName, and inlines the colors the theme uses.
The smoke fixture prints the same label as before.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: chore(lint): make oxlint ignores consistent and lint chat scripts
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
One pattern now skips both rolldown configs (runtime's .js and the SDK
CLI's .mjs): they are bundler inputs outside every tsconfig, so
type-aware rules only report unresolved types there.

The chat helper script is linted now. An override turns off the
no-unsafe-* rules for scripts/*.mjs for the same reason; the remaining
finding (prefer import.meta.dirname) is fixed.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: chore(examples): drop the empty @vitadeck/examples workspace package
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
It only declared a dev dependency on the SDK, which every example already
declares itself; nothing referenced it. The per-example package.json,
tsconfig.json and vitadeck-env.d.ts stay: they already extend the SDK
preset and mirror the author scaffold, so sharing more would make the
examples less representative without removing meaningful duplication.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: refactor(examples): drop manual memoization in minesweeper
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
The React Compiler handles it; behaviour is unchanged.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: docs(sdk): document vitadeck.config.json, assets, and generated types
commits.author: Máté Molnár

commits.subject: chore(docs): delete stray scroll-container explainer
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
It was an AI-generated internals walkthrough added with the Scroll
container; nothing links to it and src/ui/scroll.c is the source of truth.
